Description

This data element identifies this vehicle’s involvement in a rollover or overturn during the crash. Rollover is defined as any vehicle rotation of 90° or more about any true longitudinal or lateral axis. Rollover can occur at any time during the crash.

Notes

Data are not available from 1975 to 1977. Prior to 2016 the Data Element ID was V26. From 2016 to 2019 the Data Element ID was V27. Starting in 2022 this data element is derived from the “Sequence of Events” data element for each vehicle with an event equal to 01. See Appendix B: Rules for Derived Data Elements for an explanation of this data element and how it is derived. This data element also appears in the Person data file.
